summary: 一个物种移到新地区后，影响可能从局部竞争到整个生态系统的改变。文章比较灰松鼠、水葫芦等实例，说明危害易被低估，也介绍国际协作和个人防止物种扩散的作用。

paragraphs.brief: 入侵的判据是生态系统
sentences: Invasive species are among the leading threats to the native wildlife of most countries, with approximately 42 percent of endangered species at risk from them.
入侵物种是多数国家本地野生生物面临的主要威胁之一，约百分之四十二的濒危物种受到它们威胁。
Invasive species can be any kind of organism – for example, a mammal, amphibian, fish, insect or plant – that is not native to an ecosystem.
凡非某一生态系统原生的生物都可能成为入侵种，例如哺乳动物、两栖动物、鱼、昆虫或植物。
Often they reproduce and spread with great speed.
它们通常繁殖、扩散得很快。
Contrary to popular belief, a plant or animal classified as an invasive species does not necessarily originate in another country.
与人们所认为的相反，被划为入侵物种的植物或动物不一定来自另一个国家。

For example, lake trout are native to the Great Lakes of North America, but are considered to be an invasive species in Yellowstone Lake in Wyoming because they compete with native cutthroat trout for habitat.
例如，湖红点鲑原产北美五大湖，但到了怀俄明州的黄石湖，它会与当地的割喉鳟争夺栖息地，因此成了入侵种。
paragraphs.gist: 入侵取决于物种是否属于当地生态系统，即使同在北美，五大湖原生的湖红点鲑到了黄石湖也会与当地鱼争夺栖息地。

paragraphs.brief: 食物网改变与多样性流失
sentences: When a new species is introduced into an ecosystem, native wildlife may struggle to compete with it for food and other resources.
新物种进入生态系统时，本地野生生物可能难以与它争夺食物和其他资源。
Invasive species can change the food web in an ecosystem by destroying or replacing native food sources, while providing little or no food for local wildlife.
入侵物种可能摧毁或取代本地食物来源，自身却几乎不能为当地动物提供食物，从而改变食物网。
In extreme cases, the invader may prey on the native species.
在极端情况下，入侵者还可能捕食本地物种。
Above all, invasive species threaten biodiversity in many habitats.
最重要的是，入侵物种威胁到许多生境的生物多样性。

For instance, the climbing plant species kudzu (which is native to East Asia) can easily replace a habitat that had a wide range of plants with a monoculture consisting solely of kudzu, as has started to happen in the south-east of the USA.
原产东亚的攀援植物葛藤能迅速把原来生长多种植物的地方变成只有葛藤的群落，美国东南部已开始出现这种现象。
paragraphs.gist: 入侵者会争夺资源、捕食本地物种或取代食物来源，例如美国东南部的葛藤能把原先多样的植被变成单一群落。

paragraphs.brief: 交通、气候和放生加快扩散
sentences: The phenomenon is not an exclusively modern one.
这并不是什么全新的现象。
Humans have always transferred a variety of species from one region to another, but the development of rapid means of transportation has increased the frequency of such introductions.
人类一直会把物种从一地带到另一地，但快速交通工具的发展使这种引入更加频繁。
Aquatic organisms can be shipped across the oceans, while insects can easily get into the wooden crates that are transported around the world in this way.
水生生物能随船跨洋，昆虫也容易钻进运往世界各地的木箱。
In addition, climate change has enabled some invasive plant species to colonise new areas.
气候变化还让一些入侵植物得以在新区域定居。
Other invasive species include pets such as snakes or turtles which are intentionally set free into the wild.
还有些入侵者是人有意放归野外的宠物，例如蛇和龟。
paragraphs.gist: 人类早就会搬动物种，现代海运、货箱夹带、主动放生和气候变暖又扩大了物种进入并定居新地区的机会。

paragraphs.brief: 从局部共存到挤压单一物种
sentences: Invasive species do not all present the same level of threat to native ecosystems and can be classified into three types.
入侵物种对本地生态系统的威胁程度不尽相同，可分为三类。
The first of these may be introduced species which can maintain themselves in a limited range of habitats without upsetting the ecological equilibrium of the area.
第一类能在有限的栖息环境中维持种群，又不打破当地生态平衡。
Some scientists have even argued that in these cases the introduction enhances the diversity of animal and plant life in that specific area.
一些科学家甚至认为，这类引入能增加当地动植物的多样性。
A second group of invaders present a greater threat because their spread is at the expense of one native species.
第二类的威胁较大，因为其扩散是以某一种本地物种的衰退为代价的。

The North American grey squirrel, for example, was introduced to the UK in 1876 largely because wealthy landowners thought it would be a fashionable and attractive addition to the local wildlife on their estates.
例如，1876年北美灰松鼠被引进英国，主要是因为富有的地主觉得，在庄园里添上这种动物既时髦又好看。
It spread widely, leading directly to the dramatic decline in the population of the native red squirrel.
它后来广泛扩散，直接导致本地红松鼠种群锐减。
However, it would appear that this is the only definite negative impact of the grey squirrel.
然而，这似乎是灰松鼠的唯一明确的负面影响。
paragraphs.gist: 有些引入种只在局部生存，甚至可能增加多样性；另一类会显著挤压某一种本地动物，英国灰松鼠与红松鼠即是例子。

paragraphs.brief: 黑海栉水母改变整个生态
sentences: There is a third level of threat in which the dominance of the introduced species has an extremely destructive effect on the entire ecosystem.
第三级威胁是，引进物种的主导地位对整个生态系统具有极大的破坏作用。
One of the most damaging examples involved a species of comb jellyfish.
最具破坏性的例子之一涉及一种栉水母。

Native to estuaries along the western Atlantic coast from the northern United States to the Valdés Peninsula in Argentina, this species was released from a ship into the Black Sea in Eastern Europe in 1982, almost certainly by accident.
这种动物原产大西洋西岸河口，北起美国北部、南至阿根廷瓦尔德斯半岛，1982年几乎可以确定是随船意外进入了东欧的黑海。
The Black Sea has levels of industrial waste which are by international standards exceptionally high.
按国际标准衡量，黑海的工业废物含量高得异常。
Despite this, fishing boats were still able to catch healthy numbers of fish.
即便如此，渔船原本还能获得可观的渔获。

But when the invading jellyfish underwent a population explosion in the space of just six years, the entire marine ecosystem was transformed, and fish numbers declined dramatically because they were in competition with the jellyfish, preying on exactly the same microscopic creatures.
但入侵的栉水母短短六年内数量暴增，因与鱼类争食同样的微小生物，使鱼群锐减，整个海洋生态系统也发生了改变。
The jellyfish had a more serious impact on the ecosystem than the heavily polluted water.
这些水母对生态系统造成的影响甚至比严重的水污染还大。
paragraphs.gist: 第三类入侵者会改变整个生态系统，黑海栉水母六年内暴增，与鱼类争夺微小猎物，其影响甚至超过严重的工业污染。

paragraphs.brief: 凤眼莲从展品到水道威胁
sentences: More than a century after its introduction outside its native range on the Amazon River in South America, a plant known as a water hyacinth can be found in tropical lakes, streams, and rivers around the world.
凤眼莲原产南美亚马逊河，引到原生区域外一个多世纪后，如今已遍布世界各地的热带湖泊、溪流和河流。
Its beauty attracted botanists seeking exotic plants for botanical gardens and they imported it to a horticultural exhibition in New Orleans in 1884.
它的美貌吸引了为植物园寻找异国植物的植物学家，他们在1884年把它引入新奥尔良的一场园艺展。

Visitors were so impressed they planted it in many locations during the 1880s and 1890s, resulting in the aquatic ecosystems of the south-eastern United States being progressively colonised by vast, floating, dense carpets of water hyacinth.
访客大为喜爱，在十九世纪八九十年代把它种到许多地方，美国东南部的水域逐渐被大片浓密、漂浮的凤眼莲覆盖。
Today it is present around the globe, damaging boat engines and even blocking cooling pipes for power plants, occasionally leading to massive blackouts.
如今它分布全球，能损坏船舶发动机，甚至堵塞发电厂冷却管道，偶尔引发大范围停电。
The impact of the water hyacinth on native water plants is largely unstudied, as is unfortunately the case for most ecosystems invaded by new plant species.
凤眼莲对本地水生植物的影响少有人研究；遗憾的是，多数遭外来植物入侵的生态系统也面临同样情况。
paragraphs.gist: 凤眼莲因园艺展而广泛传播，密集漂浮的植株损害船机并堵塞电站冷却管道，但它对当地水生植物的影响仍少有研究。

paragraphs.brief: 外来种危害与监管缺口
sentences: In the United States, more than 7,000 introduced species have established themselves, of which at least 15 percent cause ecological damage.
美国已有七千余种引入物种建立了种群，其中至少百分之十五造成了生态损害。
As the number of invasive species expands, legislation to deal with this problem is rare or non-existent in the majority of countries.
入侵物种不断增多，但大多数国家几乎没有、甚至完全没有应对这一问题的法规。

Unfortunately, ordinary people outside the scientific community have a very limited understanding of the threat posed by invasive species, which means that other environmental threats receive considerably more media attention.
不幸的是，科学界以外的普通人对入侵物种构成的威胁的了解非常有限，这意味着其他环境威胁受到媒体更多的关注。
The introduction of new species can initially seem highly desirable, but the full extent of their impact is consistently underestimated.
引进新物种起初也许显得十分有利，人们却一再低估它所能造成的全部影响。
paragraphs.gist: 美国已定居的外来物种有七千多种，至少百分之十五会造成生态损害，可许多国家法规不足，公众也常低估长期影响。

paragraphs.brief: 个人如何减少入侵扩散
sentences: Although ultimately measures need to be taken at an international level, limited action is possible by individuals.
最终还需各国共同采取措施，但个人也可以在力所能及的范围内行动。
One way is for people to plant native plants in their gardens rather than species from abroad.
个人可在自家花园种本地植物，避免引种国外物种。
It is also useful to learn to identify invasive species, and report any sightings to wildlife organisations.
学习识别入侵物种并向野生动物组织报告任何目击情况也是有用的。
Regularly cleaning clothing, boots, boats, tyres, and any other equipment regularly used outdoors can remove insects and plant parts that may introduce invasive species into new locations.
经常清洗户外使用的衣物、靴子、船只、轮胎等装备，能清除可能把入侵物种带往新地点的昆虫和植物碎片。
paragraphs.gist: 个人可种植本地植物、识别并报告入侵种，还可清洁鞋靴和船具等户外装备，减少昆虫与植物碎片被带去新地点的机会。

items.en: a suggestion that people have moved numerous species across the globe throughout history
items.zh: 提到历史上人类曾将许多物种带往世界各地。
items.why: 文中说人类历史上一直把多种生物从一个地区移往另一个地区，快速交通只是让转移更频繁。

items.en: an example of how an ecosystem can be damaged very rapidly
items.zh: 生态系统如何迅速受损的例子
items.why: 入侵水母只用六年就暴增并改变整个海洋生态系统，说明破坏可在短期内发生。

items.en: a description of what can be done to restrict the spread of invasive species
items.zh: 说明可以采取哪些措施限制入侵物种的扩散
items.why: 清理衣物、靴子、船和轮胎可移除随行的昆虫与植物残片，从而限制入侵物种扩散。

items.en: a reference to the lack of research on the effects of some invasive species
items.zh: 提到有些入侵物种造成的影响缺少研究。
items.why: 水葫芦对本土水生植物的影响几乎未获研究，许多被外来植物入侵的生态系统也有类似空白。

items.en: a mention of a current lack of public awareness of the problem of invasive species
items.zh: 提到目前公众对入侵物种问题的认识不足
items.why: 科学界以外的普通人对入侵物种的威胁了解有限，直接对应公众认识不足。

items.en: an indication that an introduced species may benefit a specific ecosystem
items.zh: 说明引进的物种可能有益于特定生态系统
items.why: 有学者认为在某些情况下，引入新物种反而可提高当地动植物多样性。

items.en: Which TWO reasons for the spread of invasive species are mentioned in the text?
items.zh: 文中提到了入侵物种传播的哪两个原因？
correct: the deliberate release of non-native animals
an extension of their geographical range as a result of global warming
全球变暖扩大了这些物种的地理分布范围。

items.en: Which TWO statements does the writer make about the water hyacinth?
items.zh: 关于水葫芦，作者提出了哪两种说法？
correct: It was brought to North America in the late nineteenth century.
它在十九世纪末被带到北美。
Its spread has caused some practical problems in recent years.
近年来，水葫芦的蔓延引发了一些实际问题。

items.en: Kudzu has reduced the ________of certain areas in the south-east of the USA.
items.zh: 葛藤使美国东南部某些地区的________有所下降。
items.why: 定位句说：“最重要的是，入侵物种威胁到许多生境的生物多样性。”

items.en: Some introduced species present a low level of threat if they remain within a small area and do not disturb the ________of the surrounding ecosystem.
items.zh: 有些外来物种只要局限在一小片区域内，且不扰乱周围生态系统的________，其威胁就比较小。
items.why: 定位句说：“第一类能在有限的栖息环境中维持种群，又不打破当地生态平衡。”

items.en: The effect of invasive jellyfish in the Black Sea was greater than that ________from factories.
items.zh: 在黑海，入侵水母造成的影响甚至超过了来自工厂的________所造成的影响。
items.why: 定位句说：“按国际标准衡量，黑海的工业废物含量高得异常。”

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词。

pairs: 题干用动词，定位句改用同词根的名词。
points: 入侵水母只用六年就暴增并改变整个海洋生态系统，说明破坏可在短期内发生。
定位句说：“最重要的是，入侵物种威胁到许多生境的生物多样性。”
clauses: For example, lake trout are native to the Great Lakes of North America, but are considered to be an invasive species in Yellowstone Lake in Wyoming ….
连接词 because 引出“because they compete with native cutthroat trout for habitat”，说明主句的原因关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 because 把这一层关系补进去。
Invasive species can change the food web in an ecosystem by destroying or replacing native food sources, ….
连接词 while 引出“while providing little or no food for local wildlife”，说明主句的时间或对比关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 while 把这一层关系补进去。

需借助显微镜才能看到的
